messages:
Ava - Product: Quick async check — Q2 milestone snapshot for Shipline. Who shipped, who slipped, and top blockers? Please paste one-line per owner + deps. Need a short rollup by EOD. :eyes:

Sara P: Shipped: caching PR (runtime-v2) merged yesterday, smoke QA passed. Owner: Sara P. Dep: infra GPU pool-3 rollout (Ken).

Ken L: Pool-3 rollout scheduled Wed 11:00 PT, ETA ~2hrs for warmup. Ticket infra#452. No blockers at the moment.

Jin (Runtime): Quantization PR still in review; waiting on perf benches from pool-3. Slipping ~3 days if benches need tuning. Owner: Jin. Blocker: bench infra + kernel selection.

Marco - EngPM: Action items from me: 1) @Ken L confirm pool readiness, 2) @Jin complete bench run, 3) @Sara P hold canary until telemetry OK.

Ava - Product: Thanks Marco. If Jin slips, plan fallback to smaller batch sizes to keep release window. Keep updates short.

Sara P: Canary config we'll use once pool is green:
```
canary: 10%
route: region-eu -> runtime-v2-quant
fallback: runtime-v2-fp16
```

Ken L: roll started — deploy-bot: starting pool-3 rollout now...

deploy-bot: pool-3 build 2026.03.12-17:12 started (1765560200)
deploy-bot: health checks passing on pool-3 :white_check_mark: (1765560800)

deploy-bot: pool-3 roll complete at 1765561000

Jin (Runtime): Quick bench summary: quant on pool-3 shows ~5% perf regression vs fp16 for 2k context; memory reduction is good though. Investigating kernel path. Still aiming for Fri but may need +48–72h tuning.

Ava - Product: Noted. If tuning not done by Fri AM, we revert canary and update release notes. @Marco can you draft the rollback comms?

Marco - EngPM: Draft in progress, will post to #eng-releases and notify support within 2hrs.

Sara P: I'll hold canary toggle until final telemetry and ack from Marco. :thumbsup:

Ken L: final telemetry looks stable, last smoke at 1765563450

Ava - Product: Short summary for stakeholders: shipped — caching PR; slipped — runtime quant PR (~3d to tune); next steps — continue perf tuning, prepare rollback plan, schedule canary when pool telemetry green. Thanks all :rocket:
